article.story: ORONO, Maine -- — Mekhi Gray and Logan Carey each had 13 points in Maine's 52-49 win against Albany on Thursday night. Gray shot 5 of 8 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Black Bears (4-17, 2-4 America East Conference). Logan Carey shot 5 of 8 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line. Ace Flagg shot 4 of 7 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points, while adding eight rebounds. Abdoulaye Fall finished with 16 points for the Great Danes (7-13, 3-2). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
